categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the steel industry, focusing on steel billet and steel wire rod manufacturing and sales. It also engages in surface treatment processes, scrap metal processing, and non-metallic mineral product manufacturing. The business includes integrated steel production from scrap to finished steel products and related services such as cutting and bending.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes electric arc furnace (EAF) technology for steelmaking, integrating refining and rolling processes. It emphasizes automation and AI-enabled process control to improve production efficiency and reduce energy and material consumption. The company also invests in energy management systems (ISO 50001) and greenhouse gas emission monitoring (ISO 14064-1) to enhance environmental performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic steel wire rod consumers, including construction, manufacturing, and infrastructure sectors. The company serves the domestic market predominantly, with a focus on supplying steel products for public construction projects and industrial applications. It also targets specialized markets such as automotive, aerospace, and high-value-added steel products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with production facilities located in Kaohsiung. Its sales are concentrated in the domestic market, although it is influenced by international steel price trends and global economic conditions. The company monitors global steel supply-demand dynamics, including major steel-producing countries like China, the US, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, producing steel billets and wire rods from scrap metal and steel billets. It controls upstream raw material procurement (scrap iron) and downstream processing (cutting, bending, surface treatment). It also manages inventory and supply chain risks related to raw material price volatility and availability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing automation and AI capabilities in steelmaking and rolling processes to improve efficiency and reduce costs. The company focuses on energy conservation, carbon emission reduction, and compliance with environmental regulations. R&D efforts target improving scrap sorting accuracy, process optimization, and developing high-value-added steel products to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of steel billets, steel wire rods, and related processed steel products. The company also earns income from value-added services such as steel cutting, bending, and surface treatment. Revenue is influenced by steel market prices, production volumes, and domestic demand for steel products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic steel wire rod manufacturer in Taiwan, holding a significant market share with stable sales volumes. It faces competition from international steel producers, especially from China, which exerts price pressure due to large-scale production. The company differentiates itself through product quality, certifications, and integrated production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues around NT$9.7 billion with a slight growth of approximately 4% year-over-year. Operating profit margins have declined due to raw material price fluctuations and increased energy costs. The company maintains a stable financial structure with total assets exceeding NT$10 billion and equity around NT$4.2 billion, showing moderate growth and investment in capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality steel products with multiple certifications (CNS, ASTM, JIS, BS) to meet diverse customer standards. It offers integrated production from scrap to finished steel, ensuring supply stability and product consistency. The use of advanced automation and AI enhances production efficiency and environmental compliance, providing customers with reliable and sustainable steel solutions.
